map<pair<int, int>, long long> all_cache;
map<tuple<int, int, int>, long long> limit_cache;
int n = 0, m = 0;

long long compute_all(int start, int end) {
    if (start == end) {
        return 1;
    }
    pair<int, int> key = make_pair(start, end);
    if (all_cache.find(key) != all_cache.end()) {
        return all_cache[key];

    all_cache[key] = 0;
    all_cache[key] += compute_all(start + 1, end);
    all_cache[key] += compute_all(start, end - 1);
    for (int i = start + 1; i < end; ++i) {
        all_cache[key] += compute_all(start, i - 1) * compute_all(i + 1, end);
    }
    return all_cache[key];
}

long long compute_limit(int start, int end, int depth) {
    if (start == end) {
        return (depth < m) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    tuple<int, int, int> key = make_tuple(start, end, depth);
    if (limit_cache.find(key) != limit_cache.end()) {
        return limit_cache[key];
    }
    limit_cache[key] = 0;
    limit_cache[key] += compute_limit(start + 1, end, depth + 1);

    for (int i = start + 1; i < end; ++i) {
        limit_cache[key] += compute_limit(start, i - 1, depth + 1) * compute_limit(i + 1, end, depth + 1);
    }
    return limit_cache[key];
}

int main() {

    long long total = compute_all(1, n) - compute_limit(1, n, 1);
